To find out how long it will take Bob to dig the hole, we need to follow these steps:

1. **Calculate the volume of the hole:**
   The dimensions of the hole are 6 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 3 feet deep.
   $$\text{Volume} = \text{length} \times \text{width} \times \text{depth}$$
   $$\text{Volume} = 6 \times 4 \times 3 = 72 \text{ cubic feet}$$

2. **Calculate the total time required:**
   It takes Bob 3 seconds to shovel one cubic foot of earth.
   $$\text{Total time} = \text{Volume} \times \text{time per cubic foot}$$
   $$\text{Total time} = 72 \times 3 = 216 \text{ seconds}$$

Final answer: 216
